Three fair coins are tossed. If the first head occurs on the first toss, you score 1 point. If the first head occurs on toss 2 or on toss 3, you score 2 or 3 points, respectively. If no heads appear, you lose 1 point (that is score $-1$ point). Let $X$ denote the number of heads and $Y$ denote the points scored. What is the probability that fewer than three heads will occur and you will score 1 or less? Write your answer correct to two decimal places.
